Dear Dale,

Thank you for applying to Cabaka Credit. Here is what we suggest for your $7,900 knee surgery bill.

Step 1: Ask the hospital for help first. The hospital is a nonprofit. It has a program that may lower your bill or wipe it out. This option costs $0 a month, has 0% APR, and has a $0 total cost. You can also ask them to look at the $1,260 imaging bill.

Step 2: If you still owe money after that, our 24-month loan at 9% APR can cover it. If you borrow the full $7,900, you would pay $360.91 a month for 24 months, for a total cost of $8,661.83.

Please stay away from the "0% for 12 months" medical card. If it is not paid off in time, you could be charged $2,132.21 in extra interest.

Why this helps your home plan: taking on little or no new debt keeps your credit and your budget healthy. That way you can still try to buy a house in 12 months.

This is not a promise of approval. A loan officer will make the final decision.

Cabaka Credit
